clusters.scope: Themed decorative add-ins; mix contents, pack unit and MOQ confirmed by SKU.
Finished decorative non-edible slices; no unbaked clay or edible ingredients.
Buying and sample-selection guide. Not a tutorial for manufacturing sprinkles or edible use.
Stringing beads versus no-hole fillers must be separated. Size and material are SKU-specific.
Resin/acrylic focal designs only; no silicone focal-bead offer. Hole size/direction and sample fit required.
Guide about purchasing and testing the filler; not a finished slime offer or recipe.
Loose decorative sequins; no sequin fabric, clothing, trims, sewing pins or iron-on patches.
Existing resin category is primary. Mixed shopping/tutorial SERP; exclude casting resin, molds, gems and pouring tutorials.
Component selection and layout guide; do not imply glue, cream, blank cases or a complete kit are included.
Material confirmed individually; generic PVC query is mixed intent. No shoe-fit/button attachment promise.
Decorative miniature scenes and photo props, not edible food. No common dollhouse scale or outdoor durability inferred.

clusters.scope: Finished designs and hardware distinguished; no blank photo inserts, licensed characters, bottle openers or US manufacturing claims.
Reference actual assembly parts and their included contents; no silicone beads or wood supply claim.
Discussion and sample-approval service. Feasibility, material, price, MOQ and lead time confirmed by email. No price promise or blanket manufacturing capability.
Selected findings and craft components. Exclude solid gold, gold-filled, copper, sterling silver and unverified metal grades.
Lobster and spring clasp listings; compare dimensions, opening and attachment before assembly.
Whole supply-list guide, with QULA offering the decorative add-in portion. Glue/activator and finished slime are not inferred offers.
Tabletop woodland selection guide. No fixed scale, weather resistance, live-plant use or complete garden kit promise.
